notes.title: Pre-release Update v0.3.0b
notes.content:
Major Additions:

 Added Russian localization
 Added French localization


Added Autosave

 The game will now automatically save your progress after you do one of the following events:

 Win/lose a battle
 Exit the shop
 Exit the unit manager(accessed via Units Button)

 DEV NOTE: The Autosave feature is not exactly a proper saving system, but for now it will do.
I plan on expanding upon the saving system in a future update, in order to include:

 A user interface
 Ability to save/erase/overwrite a save file.
 Statistics from a save file(ex: Current Gold, Current Skill Points, Current Units, etc)


Updated Settings Window

 Added the option to change the language
 Added the option to change the display mode(Pixelated/Anti-alias)
 Added a confirmation window when trying to reset progress
 Settings data is now saved after closing the Settings Window


Updated Title Scene

 Added continue button

 DEV NOTE: Currently this is used in order to access autosaved games.
In the future this will be used to access the Save/Load interface.

 Added settings button


Updated Battle Scene

 The player now always starts the battle first.
